title: GRAIL GRGM1200A Bouguer Disturbance Map, degree 660, 16 pixel/degree (GGGRX_1200A_BOUG_L660, PDS release 2016-04-01)

links.label: EXTRAS GeoTIFF with the same values

statements.text: NASA GSFC GRAIL Level-2 team, GRGM1200A gravity field; the label names Lemoine et al. (2014), Geophysical Research Letters, doi:10.1002/2014GL060027, as its current best reference. NASA PDS Geosciences Node.
Publicly archived NASA mission scientific data; preserve producer and PDS citation.
Values lie on a 1738.0 km reference sphere in the lunar principal-axis frame of DE430; the EXTRAS GeoTIFF's Moon_2000 1737.4 km ellipsoid tag is a GIS container setting, not the product's reference.
statements.evidence: PDS3 label IMAGE_MAP_PROJECTION and DESCRIPTION; GeoTIFF GeoKeys.
